files.patch_reason: S9 (B12): two AAS operations added to the table, both ALLOW for the owner and for agents: app.build (offline Docker build; plan gate and 5 GiB disk gate apply) and device.control (studio emulator; owner device setting and disk/preflight gates apply), so builds and device actions run through Studio.operation (policy + audit) instead of the default-deny for unknown operations; S9b: app.export = APPROVAL for the owner and for agents (the approval is bound to the artifact sha256); no other change.

AAS value redaction: audit.redact now also runs activity.sanitize_text (ANSI/C0/C1/bidi/tag/zero-width) and then activity.redact_text over string values (tokens, sk-/ghp_/AKIA keys, JWT, PEM, high-entropy runs, the live owner token), so a control character cannot split a secret and audit rows, tool_executions and approval params never store a secret value (DESIGN.md 5.3, P6c); import of studio_core.activity added. S6 (S2 review F1/F2): dict keys are sanitised before the secret-key check and a well-formed lowercase sha256/git digest under a hash-named key is kept verbatim (activity.hash_type_for_key / valid_hash); no other change.

ProjectKind seam: removed imports of component_model, renderer, templates, codefiles, scene3d, animation_model; Studio(kind=...) resolves project_kind on use; _render -> kind.build; create_project takes settings from kind.initial_settings (no template components); export_project archives kind.publish() root/exclude and verifies kind.publish().required (an empty requirement is never verified); write_file/delete_file validate via kind.validate and kind.max_files/max_total_bytes, delete_file resolves the kind inside the audited operation; read_file does its own NotFound lookup; removed website methods add/update/remove/move_component, set_theme, set_animations, _insert_component, _get_component; _apply_components rejects models that carry components instead of re-validating them with component_model; S2: projects get kind=self.kind.name and project_to_dict reports it, write_file refuses a path that differs from an existing file only by case, Studio.operation also records a tool.call activity event (activity.record_operation, never raises; project.create passes the id of the project it created), _git_model adds the project kind to the git snapshot, and get_external_mcp/set_external_mcp (owner-only, audited) store the PX1 flag in app_settings; F3: _git_roots() passes the kind's file_roots (default ('site',)) to gitrepo.commit_revision and diff_stat; O8: request_approval refuses (PolicyDenied) an agent identity that already created MAX_APPROVALS_PER_AGENT (50) approval records (a runner:<run_id> label over the whole run; any other agent label, e.g. the external-MCP one, within a rolling APPROVAL_WINDOW_HOURS (24 h) window so it cannot lock forever); R2: Studio.workspace validates the project id with re.fullmatch (a trailing newline no longer passes `$`); wow2 B2a: peek_project (owner read endpoints: policy enforced, no audit row and no run-less project.inspect activity event) and read_file(quiet=...) that uses it.
AAS: Project.kind column (String(24), default/server_default 'app'; alembic 0003); the AAS-owned tables (activity_events, app_settings) live in aas_models.py, not here.
R2: is_valid_id / is_valid_slug use re.fullmatch instead of re.match, so a trailing newline (which `$` accepts) is rejected; no other change.

AAS identity: only AAS_* env vars are read (AAS_DATA_DIR, AAS_API_PORT, AAS_PREVIEW_PORT, AAS_AGENT_ID, AAS_DATABASE_URL); AWS_* is ignored; data root %LOCALAPPDATA%/AIAppStudio; api_port 17875, new preview_port 17880. S9 (B11): the vite dev origins localhost:1420 / 127.0.0.1:1420 are removed from allowed_origins (dev UIs only via AAS_DEV_ORIGINS with run_studio.ps1 -Dev).

F3: commit_revision and diff_stat take the kind's file roots (paths=, default ('site',) as upstream); roots are plain top-level names (validated); only roots that exist or are tracked are staged, because a pathspec that matches nothing made `git add` fail and an app project (src/, public/, no site/) was never committed.

desktop capture: the lazy import of computer_use.windows.capture_bitmap moved before the audited operation and an ImportError raises Unavailable (computer_use is not vendored), so no `ok` audit row is written for a capture that cannot run; AAS identity: the browsers path comes from AAS_PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH via local_browsers_path() (AWS_PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is ignored); no other change.
AAS identity: model overrides read AAS_CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL, AAS_ANTHROPIC_MODEL, AAS_OPENAI_MODEL, AAS_GEMINI_MODEL (the AWS_* names are ignored); no other change.

AAS boundary: X-AAS-Token header and 'aas.token.' WebSocket subprotocol replace the AWS ones (the AWS names are not accepted), BoundaryMiddleware refuses a token shorter than 32 characters; no other change.
